_comment: v1.16.0 - Sallust opens: four chapters of the Catilina (the proem, the author on himself, and the two 'before' chapters of the archaeology) plus the two v1.0.0 launch excerpts rebuilt through the pipeline (Cat. 5, now whole with section 9, and Iug. 85, now the unbroken run 10-17). sall.1 prints its subsection numbers as BARE DIGITS, which extract.js turns into **n.**, so every Catilina passage starts ON its digit. sall.2 prints none; batch/marks1160.json adds them from Perseus.
iug.85: Bellum me gerere cum Iugurtha iussistis
